say:2:1821002001:0.text: Tephesia oversees the Syndicate's operations in all of Bantus? I thought her authority didn't extend beyond Novaris.
say:2:1821002001:0.source_cn: 苔佩希竟然是整个班题斯大区的负责人！我以为她只负责管理...

say:3:1821002002:0.text: ... She's more powerful within the Syndicate than I realized.
say:3:1821002002:0.source_cn: ……她在黑金商会里的地位比我预想的更高。

choice_prompt:4:1821002002.text: ... She's more powerful within the Syndicate than I realized.
choice_prompt:4:1821002002.source_cn: ……她在黑金商会里的地位比我预想的更高。

say:5:1821002004:2.text: Novaris only joined Bantus later and still governs itself. Putting its ruler in charge of the Syndicate's entire regional operation doesn't make sense.
say:5:1821002004:2.source_cn: 诺珐斯是后期归附的自治领地，黑金商会却委任其领主统管整...

say:6:1821002005:0.text: Agreed. Back in Twilight Village, it was clear that Tephesia and the Bantus commander were already at odds.
say:6:1821002005:0.source_cn: 嗯，而且在夕染村时我就注意到，苔佩希和那个班题斯将领之...

choice_prompt:7:1821002006.text: The more time they spend undermining each other, the less danger they pose to Lightbearers.
choice_prompt:7:1821002006.source_cn: 只要他们彼此算计，就算是对耀光有利。

say:8:1821002006:0.text: The more time they spend undermining each other, the less danger they pose to Lightbearers.
say:8:1821002006:0.source_cn: 只要他们彼此算计，就算是对耀光有利。

choice:7:0:1.text: It's a Syndicate matter. Bantus has little say in it.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 毕竟是黑金内部的事，班题斯很难插手
choice:7:0:1.male: It's a Syndicate matter. Bantus has little say in it.
choice:7:0:1.female: It's a Syndicate matter. Bantus has little say in it.

choice:7:1:2.text: They still work together, despite their differences.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 至少现在他们还在合作
choice:7:1:2.male: They still work together, despite their differences.
choice:7:1:2.female: They still work together, despite their differences.

choice:7:2:3.text: Things would get interesting if they turned on each other.
choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 要是他们内讧就有意思了
choice:7:2:3.male: Things would get interesting if they turned on each other.
choice:7:2:3.female: Things would get interesting if they turned on each other.

choice:4:0:1.text: She really earned the title of Sloth.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 难怪她那么懒，不愧是“懒惰”
choice:4:0:1.male: She really earned the title of Sloth.
choice:4:0:1.female: She really earned the title of Sloth.

say:10:1821002003:0.text: Perhaps she's proud of the promotion and likes to admire it from time to time.
say:10:1821002003:0.source_cn: 也许她对此身份颇为自豪，所以时不时就拿出来观赏一番。

choice:4:1:2.text: Leaving such crucial documents lying around so carelessly...
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 这么重要的文件居然随意乱放
